messages.subject: Re: Instruction and trial page in mirtCAT
parts:
Probably the easiest way to do this is to include a blank, unscored item prior to each section, where the item contains the instructions (see the df object definition with the option 'none'). 

Phil


On Wed, Sep 29, 2021 at 9:55 AM Hanif Akhtar <hanif.a...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear All,

I'm a new user of mirtCAT, and I've found it to be quite useful in my research. I'm trying to create a multidimensional CAT, and so far, so good. But I have a question regarding the inclusion of instruction and trial sessions. It might be a basic question, but here is my case:

I want to create a CAT consisting of three subtests with the item bank of 50 items for each subtest. Each subtest has different instructions. At the beginning of each subtest, there will be an "instruction page". I need to add a "trial session" in which the participants will answer three training items for each subtest and get an explanation of their answer (correct or incorrect). I tried to put the training items in my df, but then get an error message when wanted to run the mirtCAT (Rows of df object not equal to number of items in mirt object). I am also still confused about how to make the trial session and its logic jump (e.g., if they answer correctly can continue to the next training item, if they answered incorrectly, they will get an explanation). 

So how to make an instruction and trial page in mirtCAT? 
How to ensure the order (three training items come first), and implement conditional jump in the trial session? 

Any suggestion or sharing code examples of implementing instruction and trial sessions are welcomed. Thanks in advance

Hanif
